title: 3.0 beta3 - homescreen doesn't update right
symptom: BG data is coming in and calculations are being made, but on the AAPS homescreen the data isn't updating, and time looks like running back (amount of minutes of last BG reading is going up faster than actual time). Restarting AAPS and clearing cache doesn't help. The issue disappeared after 10 more minutes.
fix: The issue was reportedly fixed in 3.0-b4 or latest dev, but it reappeared on beta5. A developer reworked UI updating in dev, which would be in beta6 or current dev. However, the user reported beta6 didn't work for other reasons and reverted to master, but the issue didn't appear during beta6 use.
evidence_quote: i revorked UI updating un dev will be in beta6 or current dev
